spellbook.finance/limitations: Facts only. No store ranking, split calculation, purchase recommendation, checkout or purchase is performed.
Offers preserve native currency and exact product identity. Shipping, tax, stock and destination eligibility can remain unknown; item subtotal is not landed cost.
List reads contain at most 100 lines; offer reads contain at most 10 lines and 80 offers per product. Follow nextCursor; completeList describes saved-list traversal, never complete merchant coverage.

description: Read one saved sealed retailer price target, its activation status and observed match facts. Call after creating or changing a target. Use spellbook_sealed_price_target_update to change terms; matching facts do not establish delivery, stock or checkout completion.

alertId.description: Saved sealed retailer target alertId returned by target creation.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

name: spellbook_sealed_price_target
